variants.request: Two authenticated tenants use the same task_id and call_id against one idempotency-keyed remote mock. Distinct authorized operations must receive distinct remote keys.
Authorization callback observes a cancellation before dispatch. No new remote side effect should begin after this checkpoint.
Batch response HTTP 200 has body status incomplete/failed; account for it separately from completed and preserve usage.
Completed transport contains commentary and a function call, without final answer; projections must not represent commentary as final answer.
Check unsupported citation, negation, wrong total plus right number elsewhere, and a correct paraphrase. Distinguish narrow deterministic pattern rules from trusted general judge.
Usage omits cache or output counter; retain unknown information and distinguish measured from estimated.
